Subject: your knowledge management hire

Hi Helen,

Saw Ashby Kerr is recruiting a knowledge management lawyer. Precedents and client files spread across systems are hard to search without sending data somewhere you don't control.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is this on your radar?

Sam
Nextron AI

If you'd rather not hear from me, reply "stop". Privacy notice: https://www.example.com/nextron/privacy
Timing's wrong. We're mid-merger until the end of the year, so I can't look at anything new before then.
